narrative.overview: A sparse connected canvas keeps many repositories scannable, with detail revealed in an inspector or dialog.

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Use a colored dot or file code for state; the entire node never becomes a status badge.

dos: Do keep the canvas readable with dozens of repositories.
Do show real Git state and precise operation results.
Do keep detailed Git controls inside an inspector or dialog.
donts: Don't turn the default view into a dashboard of panels and metrics.
Don't let status colors dominate the canvas.
